reader.requirement: At --std 85 LINE integer-1 ON NEXT PAGE (allowed only in body groups and the report footing) presents the group from line integer-1 of a new page: a body group advances the page when a body group is already on the current page (or after a saved next-group integer), and is presented on the current page when it is the first body group there; a report footing goes on a page holding no other report group.

edition-consulted.switches: a bare LINE ON NEXT PAGE with no integer is a 2002 construct, refused at 85

reader.edition-search: PresentBody's NextPage branch, PresentHeadingFooting's ownPage branch and PageFeed have no edition test (grep of ReportWriter.cs for Edition|Dialect); ScreenReportLineClauses' SR7/SR8 NEXT PAGE checks are edition-independent.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for integer-1 ON NEXT PAGE (same runtime arm); yes for syntax: the bare ON NEXT PAGE operand is accepted only from 2002.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf36_07 covers a body group with a body group already on the page and a report footing NEXT PAGE; the first body group of a page with NEXT PAGE (presented on the current page) and the bare-operand refusal are not exercised

reader.notes: NEXT PAGE follows fit test rule 3c, including the case where the group is the first body group on a page and stays there. A report footing NEXT PAGE goes alone on a new page with no page heading. g85_bf36_07 matches its golden. The code skips the 3c page advance only for the first body group since INITIATE, and no other first-on-page state arises at 85 without a page advance by that same group.

refuter.evidence: npdummy (--std 85): a nonprintable DE-D (no LINE) generated first, then DE-N LINE 5 ON NEXT PAGE, printed PAGE 1 LINE 05. The dummy is not a presented body group, so 3c's 'no body group yet presented' holds. The second DE-N advanced to PAGE 2 LINE 05, and LC stayed 05 across the dummy (6e). npsave: a CH presented first, so DE-N LINE 7 NEXT PAGE advanced to page 2 line 7. With saved 9 (DE-A NEXT GROUP 9 at line 10), DE-N advanced, LC 9 >= 7 forced a second advance (page 3 holds only PH), and DE-N printed on page 4 line 7. DE-M LINE 10 NEXT PAGE with saved 9 < 10 printed on page 5 line 10 after one advance. All match 3c's second paragraph. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.3.15.4 GR5 ("presented beginning on the indicated line number on a new page"); OK §1985:XIII.3.10.8 GR3c ("If a body group has been presented on the page to which the report is currently positioned").
